stem_book: One gram sample of NH₄NO₃ (M = 80 g mol⁻¹) is decomposed in a bomb calorimeter. The temperature of the calorimeter increases by 6.12 K. The heat capacity of the system is 1.23 kJ/g/deg. What is the molar heat of decomposition for NH₄NO₃? (a) −7.53 kJ/mol (b) −398.1 kJ/mol (c) −16.1 kJ/mol (d) −602 kJ/mol
reason: Printed key letter d is right but option (d) is printed '+602'; the calorimeter warms so decomposition is exothermic — sign misprint corrected to −602 (all other options negative)
work: q = 1.23 × 6.12 = 7.53 kJ per g released; × 80 g/mol = 602 kJ → ΔU = −602 kJ/mol
